notes.title: Japanese Language Support and more
notes.content:
[b]Hello Coiners,[/b]

In this update:
[b][olist]
[*] Japanese language support added
[*] Mac version: Treasure chest bug fixed
[*] General bug fixes and stability improvements
[/olist][/b]

🎌 [b]Japanese Language Support[/b]
We’re excited to announce that Coin Pusher Casino is now available in Japanese!
This was made possible thanks to the amazing folks at [b]STP.Works[/b], who generously offered to help and took on the heavy lifting of translating the game files. They asked for nothing in return—just a suggestion to consider a co-op bundle featuring several coin pusher games.

STP.Works is a Japanese developer with several great coin pusher titles here on Steam, some of which include multiplayer features. If you're a fan of the genre, we definitely recommend checking them out!

🍎 [b]Mac Version – Treasure Chests Fixed[/b]
The so-called “smooth port” to Mac turned out to be… not so smooth. 😅
Players pointed out that treasure chests wouldn’t open properly—an issue tied to deeper Steam integration problems. We jumped on it right away, and everything should now be working as expected.

🔧[b]Bug Fixes & Stability Improvements[/b]
We fixed invisible items in Classic Level 31 and took care of several smaller bugs.
Thanks for continuing to report issues—it really helps us improve the game!

Once again, a huge thanks to the community for the feedback, and an especially big thank-you to STP.Works for helping us in such a meaningful way.

We hope you enjoy the update, and yes—we're working on more levels for the next one, as many of you requested!

[b]Cheers,[/b]
The Coin Pusher Casino Team

notes.title: Transitioning to Full Publication on February 29, 2024
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Coin Pusher Casino is taking a giant leap forward as we transition from Early Access to full publication on February 29, 2024. This leap day in a leap year marks a quantum leap for Coin Pusher Casino, and we couldn't be more excited to share this milestone with our incredible community.

First and foremost, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to our Early Access Community. Your invaluable feedback, awesome reviews, and unwavering support have been instrumental in shaping Coin Pusher Casino into the thrilling experience it is today. We also express our gratitude to Steam and the Early Access platform for providing us with the opportunity to connect with players and refine our vision.

We've made remarkable progress and exceeded even our own expectations in some aspects of the game. While we've achieved most of our goals, we acknowledge that some targets were missed. Certain features, levels, and additional arcade machines that we aimed to include at launch are still in progress. However, our commitment to delivering the best possible experience remains steadfast.

As we transition to full publication, our focus shifts towards continuous improvement and expansion. We recognize that certain aspects of the game, such as UI elements, input controls, and settings, can benefit from enhancements based on community feedback. Therefore, we'll be diligently working on Quality of Life updates to address these areas and provide players with a smoother and more customizable gaming experience.

Furthermore, we're excited to announce our plans for post-launch content. Expect to see a plethora of new and exciting additions, including more Unique Arcade Mode coin pusher machines, levels, as well as fresh Classic and Zen content. With each update, we're dedicated to delivering a wealth of new content and improvements to keep the excitement alive and the gameplay experience fresh.

We invite you to join us in shaping the future of Coin Pusher Casino. Your feedback, suggestions, and enthusiasm drive us forward, and we're committed to delivering an experience that exceeds your expectations.

Stay tuned for more updates, announcements, and surprises as we leap into the future together.

Thank you for being a part of the Coin Pusher Casino community!

[b]TreeNutsGames[/b]

notes.title: THE FIRST ARCADE MODE WHEELS 'N FORTUNES (beta) MACHINE IS HERE
notes.content:
Greetings Coiners,

For those who have dared to enter beyond the warning sign of the Arcade mode button, might have seen various states of what is to come for the first Arcade machine in its broken alpha- and pre alpha stages.
But in this update we present the machine in a playable state as beta and we would love to hear your feedback. The Arcade mode, for a stronger part then Classic and Zen, depends on your Lucky Charm Perk level. So be sure to visit the Perk Shop for better Lucky Charms.

With Arcade Mode we aim to make unique gameplay in every machine. In the first machine you will find a fortune wheel, jackpot and score multiplier. Some of the Arcade mode specials can be used, like Earth Quake and Dice. But it does not support a Score-doubler. 
Next machine (spoiler hint [bar,bar,bar]) might use an other set of specials.
Arcade mode is to be fun with lots of crazy events, blinking lights and satisfying sounds. But still should be a challenge to get it giving out its prizes. It does help however to use the powerful specials you collected in Zen and Classic mode to give you a boost and loot the machine empty. 
We hope you'll enjoy and again your feedback is appreciated.

In other news:
New coin: Pink. Pink is nice so we made it very nice. 
Next, a new song was added as background music. It's called Elemental Tones. check it out in the Zen Player playlist. 

And as always: Bugs splatted. Code bugs, no real ones.

Finally, Thank you Coiners, for the great feedback and enthusiastic reactions as well as very positive reviews we received. We will be focusing on new machines and updating existing machines, gameplay, collectibles and more levels.

Have a blast and see you soon.

notes.title: Introducing the New In-Game User Interface!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to unveil the brand new in-game user interface, meticulously designed to accommodate both keyboard/mouse and game controller inputs. This update grants players quick and seamless access to all player skill perks and options.

We are proud to announce that this implementation marks the completion of our quest to integrate all necessary game controller inputs, allowing for full gameplay using controllers.
For keyboard/mouse users, simply hover near buttons and panels to automatically extend them, ensuring easy accessibility.

For game controller users, press the interface focus button:
    • On Xbox controllers,  button [ B ] and hold a direction to navigate the selection wheel.
    • Press button [ A ] to select your desired option.

Please note that there have been some changes to keyboard inputs. For instance, the "insert coin" key is now [ left-control ], and the "skill stop" key is now [ space ]. We are actively working on a comprehensive user manual that will explain all inputs and serve as a helpful guide within the community hub.

Updates and Improvements:
    • Certain buttons and text will now adjust in size based on the screen resolution, enhancing readability on handheld devices.
    • Auto-Play now blocks the "insert coin" function, preventing players from using both simultaneously. This change limits the player's ability to add coins, and it may potentially be exclusive to the Casino difficulty in the future or become an unlockable perk.

Bug Fixes:
    • Rectified an issue where the open chest dialog displayed the incorrect level of lucky charm used.
    • Addressed various spelling errors and typos throughout the game.
    • Restored the focus for game controllers on dialog cancel.

What's Next?:
    • Stay tuned for user guides covering game inputs and gameplay mechanics.
    • In-game tutorials will soon be available to assist new players.
    • Prepare yourself for the exciting Arcade Mode.
    • We're actively developing additional levels for all game modes.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy the latest update!

[b]TreeNutsGames[/b]

notes.title: A big order!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Coiners![/b]

We're thrilled to present a substantial update that's been long overdue, packed with exciting enhancements and new features. Here's what's in store for you:

[b]Revamped User Interface:[/b]
We've expanded the implementation of our sleek new UI style throughout the menu. 
Experience a visually nicer and functionally improved perks shop, specials, and options. 
Additionally, the coin shop now has its own dedicated page, and menu buttons have been conveniently relocated to the bottom of the screen. 
Stay informed with a scrolling status text on most menu pages, providing quick updates on player levels, skills, and more. 
Plus, player credits are now constantly visible for easy tracking.

[b]Gameplay Updates:[/b]
We've fine-tuned the scene lighting and coin materials to enhance your gaming experience. 
Prepare to immerse yourself in 4 brand-new Zen levels, offering a serene and captivating challenge. 
Discover an array of exciting collectibles to enrich your gameplay. 
We've also meticulously balanced difficulty and prices for a more engaging and rewarding experience.

[b]Sound Enhancements:[/b]
Immerse yourself in an enriched auditory experience with the addition of more in-game music and captivating tunes in the menu. 
We've also incorporated new sound effects for buying, selling, and other significant actions, making your interactions more dynamic and immersive!

[b]Under the Hood:[/b]
Our diligent development team has been hard at work addressing various bug fixes, thanks to the invaluable input from our supportive community members. 
We've also made significant changes, separating coins from the perk shop. 
Furthermore, we've optimized UI navigation for game controller and keyboard input, paving the way for a seamless and versatile gaming experience. 
While still a work in progress, we've made partial preparations for multilanguage support, ensuring a more inclusive experience for players worldwide. 
Stay tuned for upcoming changes to our Arcade mode, designed to elevate your gaming enjoyment.

[b]What's on the Horizon?[/b]
Our upcoming focus areas include a comprehensive in-game UI update with the new style, along with full implementation of controller and keyboard input. 
We're also actively working on enhancing the Arcade mode gameplay code, guaranteeing an adrenaline-pumping adventure. 
And last but not least, prepare for an influx of fresh levels for both classic and Zen mode, delivering new challenges and excitement.

Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!

Cheers!

notes.title: Quality of Life update and more content
notes.content:
[b]Hello Coiners and welcome back,[/b]

Today we have some quality of life updates, a new machine, some new levels, the ability to open your treasure chests for loot, more coins to play with, tweaks and bugfixes. 
From now on the focus will be a bit less on releasing new machines and levels so often but rather bringing the game development into it's next phase.
This will shift the focus on implementing new UI, Arcade mode, Object models and sounds.
As always feel free to visit the community hub. We appreciate your feedback, critiques and comments on the discussions page.

Enjoy!

[b]TreeNutsGames[/b]



[b]Quality Of Life updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reset options added. You can now reset all or specific parts of your save file. 
This allows you to, for example, reset you perks but not your unlocked level to play them with renewed challenge. Or reset your levels but keep you perks etc.
[*] Remember Hold Insert Coin and Auto Collect. (per session)
[*] Hide mouse pointer when using keyboard or controller (use Esc or click mouse to unlock)
[*] Run in background. The game can now run in background as suggested by Coiner ZenZen and won't pause when the game is unfocused. This is particularly nice for people running the game in a window on a second monitor while doing other tasks.
[/list]

[b]Tweaks and tunings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Classic level 16 pushers speed was tweaked. Back pushers slowed down a tiny bit and front pusher sped up a tiny bit for a more balanced game.
[*] Camera positions in a few machines.
[/list]

[b]Coins added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some colourful coins where added. Please not that coins can also be found as loot in treasure chests.
[/list]

[b]Open/Use Specials:[/b]
[list]
[*] Silver treasure chests and Gold treasure chests can now be opened. Different types of loot can be found in the chests, like credits, collectibles and more. Please note that the content given is based on luck and can be lower the sale price of an unopened chest. Test your luck.
[/list]

[b]New machine added:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new slotted machine was added. This machine setup features a more traditional slotted coin insert where no more then one coin can be inserted in per slot. Coins will stack standing, creating a buffer for the next push.
A small warning: Coins can still get stuck if you jam too much coins in the machine at the same spot with AutoPlay or an over powered insert coin skill or both!
[/list]

[b]Levels added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Classic level 20 was added.
[*] Zen level 11 and 12 where added
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Perk Shop Buy Window size stretching out on ultra widescreens
[*] A small bug in the level buy in window where a unloadable level would give a loading error.
[*] AutoPlay coin amount increase was not respecting the player AutoPlay level max coin amount when using the keyboard numpad +key. This bug is fixed and was also noted by Coiner ZenZen in the community hub.
[*] Other minor bugfixes as well some save game changes that prepare for scaling the game and even changing the order of some levels in the future for a more linear level vs difficulty and cost progression. 
[/list]
